## Design

### 2026-10-29: I did the schematic and PCB for the project. I first did some thinking about what I want to actually include, and then I researched how I could do it. This is not really mean to be a multimeter replac

**3h**

I did the schematic and PCB for the project. I first did some thinking about what I want to actually include, and then I researched how I could do it. This is not really mean to be a multimeter replacement,  just a project for quickly testing circuits, and to be able to find problems, etc. For the schematic, I ended up using a XIAO RP2040 for it's relatively accurate analog inputs, important for voltage testing, and it's small space requirement, since I don't use too many pins, and I didn't want to include  a large and expensive board. I added a 4 pin header for the main connector, with 5V, 3V3, and ground pins  on the top, to make testing components a bit easier by just connecting a jumper wire, and having power, and for the bottom pin is a 5V input(I actually had a seperate 3V3 pin, but I just realized  while writing this that that was useless), which is divided int a 3V3 input to protect the RP2040's pin, because that can't take more than 3V3. Other than that I have a 2 pin header for checking continuity, which connects to 3V3 through a resistor on one end, and a pin with a pull  down resistor on the other end, to check if the 2 ends connect. Other than those, I have an I2C OLED, which was easy to wire, but the harder part with that will be to code it. Here is the final schematic:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/31a585492a67ca3a0952adc1da79043e651e7aafe0426d5755d6167054b05cea.png)

After that I started work on the PCB itself. This wasn't too complicated, but again I first had one more pin foor a 3V3 input, but that has been removed, so I had to do some modificaations, but I think this should be good. I just realized I forgot to do a ground pour, but I'll do that in the next session. Here's the final design:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/cd1a3597b274e623836489548adde9be7f5e9580149cc59f3e0c260689f775ee.png)

And a 3D render:
